description: Inspect an unsigned or partially signed Bitcoin PSBT (BIP174 base64 or hex) before signing: decodes inputs, outputs, fee, fee rate (sat/vB), change detection, sighash types, taproot/witness scripts, and flags high-fee or missing-prevout risks. Never send private keys or seed phrases.

creditToken.description: Optional WorkSats bearer credit token (`crd_...`) to pay 2 credits when free daily calls are used up.

x402TxHash.description: Optional confirmed Base mainnet USDC transfer transaction hash (`0x...`) to pay via x402.

name: check_psbt
